channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan’s new disaster agency calls on public to prepare for disasters
item.description: Goshi Hosono, who became the first chief of the agency, noted that there are limits to what the government can do in the event of a massive disaster.

item.title: Oji makes inroads on licorice cultivation in Japan
item.description: A unit of the paper manufacturer has established a large-scale harvesting system for the medicinal plant in Hokkaido to create stable supply.

item.title: BOJ signals low hopes for consumer spending as population falls
item.description: Private consumption accounts for about half of Japan's economy, making its strength a key consideration for the central bank.

item.title: Stolen luxury watch returned to Tokyo store via courier with apology note
item.description: The package containing the stolen watch had been sent from Aichi Prefecture and included a handwritten apology.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
